crossRefs.note: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness will be his reward.
“Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…

translations.web: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
translations.bsb: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your iniquities endless?
translations.kjv: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
translations.asv: Is not thy wickedness great? Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.
